_comment: Staging fragment for ONE Clek-Liing-compatible CITY / COMPACT stroller. Copy this to <option-id>.json (filename MUST equal the option id used in the new 'city-stroller' module in src/data/seed.json), fill it in, and commit ONLY this file + the image. Do NOT edit seed.json — the integration pass folds every fragment in, adds the module, and bumps dataVersion once. See ../../CLEK_STROLLER_RESEARCH_PLAN.md and ../../SOURCING.md. GATE: only source a model that is on Clek's OFFICIAL compatibility list (see _CLEK_LIST.md).
name: Human-readable model name (must match seed.json)

clekListed._comment: Proof this model is on Clek's definitive list — required before any other sourcing.

verifiedAttributes._comment: Facts to fold into the option's attributes. weightLb / foldedDimsIn / maxChildLb / adapterSystem map into seed.json and drive the summary-table chips + criterion evidence. fitsLiing / clekAdapter / adapterCost back the Clek-Liing compatibility flag.
verifiedAttributes.foldedDimsIn: L × W × H in — note self-standing? one-hand fold? cabin-legal?
verifiedAttributes.recline: seat recline (e.g. near-flat / multi-position) — city/nap relevance
verifiedAttributes.adapterSystem: How the Clek Liing attaches, e.g. 'Maxi-Cosi-style adapter (made by <brand>)' or 'Clek UPPAbaby adapter'.
verifiedAttributes.clekAdapter: Exact adapter product name + who makes it (brand vs Clek).

adapterSource._comment: The adapter is a required, citable fact. Link the exact adapter product page.
adapterSource.name: Adapter product name

notes: Anything the integration pass should know: current gen vs superseded model, in-stock vs backorder, MSRP vs sale, adapter availability caveat, how it compares to the BOB Alterrain Pro for the city/shopping use case, etc.
